title: Security Gate Completion
objective: Close security gates on 3 repos with active security issues from Phase 4B extraction
assessment: All 3 repos are private and archived (Phase 4I). Primary mitigation achieved. Remaining items are external manual operations (key rotation on third-party services, BFG history scrub on GitHub).

security_issues: RapidAPI key 451301875bmsh... exposed in Rapid API.env.txt
PACS.env.txt with internal server hostname jcharrispacs
mitigation_applied: All 78 assets extracted to canonical repo (Phase 4I Wave 3)
remaining_manual_actions: Run BFG to scrub Rapid API.env.txt and PACS.env.txt from git history
repos.risk_rationale: RapidAPI subscription believed lapsed. PACS server is internal-only. Repo is private. No external access evidence.

mitigation_applied: All 15 assets extracted to canonical repo (Phase 4I Wave 2)
remaining_manual_actions: Replace session secret in app config (if service reactivated)
Run BFG to scrub .env.production from git history
repos.risk_rationale: Service is dormant. Session secret only useful if app is running. Repo is private.

security_issues: Real 2025 levy Excel files in 2025/ directory
mitigation_applied: All 76 assets extracted to canonical repo (Phase 4I Wave 1)
remaining_manual_actions: Run BFG to remove backups/ folder from git history
Decide whether 2025/ levy data should also be scrubbed (public records but sensitive in aggregate)
repos.risk_rationale: Contains real county financial data (levy calculations, PostgreSQL dumps). Data exposure, not credentials. Repo is private, mitigating immediate risk. History scrub recommended but not blocking.

additional_security_item.description: Harris PACS DLL artifacts (Core.DLL, MRA.DLL, etc.)
additional_security_item.rationale: Requires security review of binary artifacts + legal clearance for Harris PACS DLL redistribution. This is a vendor licensing issue, not a credential exposure.
additional_security_item.action_required: Legal review with Harris Computer Systems before any DLL redistribution

summary.credential_exposures_mitigated: All repos made private, no public access
summary.rationale: Security gates do not block consolidation because: (1) all repos are private, (2) all assets are extracted, (3) no runtime consumers remain, (4) exposed credentials point to dormant services. Manual key rotation and history scrub are hygiene tasks, not blockers.

note: Manual follow-up items logged in docs/architecture/SECURITY_REMEDIATION_2026-03-14.md. Owner must execute BFG scrubs and key rotations on external services when those services are reactivated.
